source.author: lucr
source.text: haec igitur qui cuncta subegerit ex animoque expulerit dictis, non armis, nonne decebit hunc hominem numero divom dignarier esse?
source.text_original: haec igitur qui cuncta subegerit ex animoque / expulerit dictis, non armis, nonne decebit / hunc hominem numero divom dignarier esse?
source.text_english: Therefore, one who has mastered all these things and driven them from the mind by words, not by arms, would it not be fitting to count this man as worthy to be among the gods?

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: sed ille ut hominem laudauit, qui tamen ob id ipsum deberet pro deo haberi, quod sapere inuenerit: nam sic ait: nonne decebit hunc hominem numero diuum dignarier esse?
reuse.text_original: sed ille ut hominem laudauit, qui tamen ob id ipsum deberet pro deo haberi, quod sapere inuenerit: nam sic ait: nonne decebit hunc hominem numero diuum dignarier esse?
reuse.text_english: But he praised him as a man, though for that very reason he ought to be regarded as a god, because he discovered wisdom; for thus he says: Should not this man be deemed worthy to be counted among the number of the gods?
